520	Again: so that after 120 years of Rav Shach there will be someone fit to give instruction to others to go out
521	and work. That is why I stay.
522	Because if I go out to work, I will not become a Torah scholar.
523	And if I won't be a Torah scholar, I won't be able to give instruction to go out and work.
524	So that is why he stayed.
525	So Rav Shach, on Purim, a few boys from the yeshiva came to him.
526	And they sat with him, words of Torah, and there was joy.
527	Suddenly Rav Shlomo Lorincz walked in.
528	Do you remember him?
529	He was a Knesset member, he was also a deputy minister, he had...
530	What?
531	Chairman of the Finance Committee.
532	Chairman of the Finance Committee.
533	He came in, and the boys immediately understood: Rav Lorincz came in, a Knesset member, so they have to
534	make room for him, anyway, a distinguished man, he came in.
535	So they got up, and came to clear the place so he could come in, he came with mishloach manot.
536	Rav Shach signaled to them, sit down.
537	He took Rav Lorincz to the kitchen.
538	He gave him a different mishloach manot, accompanied him outside, did everything properly.
539	He came back and told them, as important as he is, and as much as he brings merit to the many, and much depends on him.
540	But yeshiva boys who sit and learn, their level is greater, they
541	and their standing is more important.
542	And he stayed to speak with these young boys, to show them that they are more important than that Knesset
543	member.
544	And so the Gemara says in Tractate Megillah, page 16b:
545	Torah study is greater than saving lives. What does it mean that Torah study is greater
546	than saving lives?
547	The Ateret Zahav says, Yoreh De'ah, Siman 251, subsection 6, Laws of Tzedakah:
548	Say there is now a suicide terrorist, may HaShem have mercy, who wants to enter
549	the mall there, Malha Mall,
550	wants to enter the mall and carry out an attack, and the security guard discovers it, immediately leaps
551	on him, brings him down to the floor, ties his hands. Let's tell a story, yes?
552	Okay, and he saved all the people of Malha Mall. They will let him light
553	a torch on Independence Day and he will receive, I don't know how you say it, some medal
554	of honor. But a yeshiva boy, or a person who sits here and learns
555	in the synagogue in this street at that same time, says the Ateret Zahav, in heaven he receives a reward much
556	higher than that security guard who saved hundreds of people. There is
557	that one, how do you say it, the plumber,
558	this plumber, yes, from the plane, I don't remember his name,
559	this plumber who saved the 170 passengers there on the plane.
